sentences.text: Court No. - 71  HON'BLE RAJ BEER SINGH, J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

2. The present third bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in S.T. No.859 of 2021,
arising out of Case Crime No.244 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 302 I.P.C., Police Station- Khaga,
District- Fatehpur, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.

3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is husband of deceased and the marriage of deceased with applicant has taken place in the year 2013 and out of that marriage they have two children.
The alleged incident took place on 22.07.2021.
It was stated that in the post-mortem report except ligature mark no other injury has been shown on the body of deceased.
Though, cause of death of deceased has been shown strangulation but the attending facts indicate that it is a case of suicide.
The first information report was also registered under Sections 306, 498A IPC, but during investigation Section 302 IPC was added.
4. It is further submitted that the first bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 12.04.2023.

While rejecting the second bail application of applicant by order dated 30.05.2024, the trial Court was directed to expedite the trial and to conclude the same as early as possible preferably within a period of nine months but since then no witness has been examined before the trial Court.
Statement of PW 1 and PW 2 have already been recorded before the trial Court.
No witness has been examined after rejection of second bail application.

It is further submitted that after rejection of second bail application of applicant, an application moved on behalf of prosecution under Section 319 Cr.P.C. has been partly allowed and some more persons were summoned as accused by the trial Court under Section 319 Cr.P.C. vide order dated 26.11.2024.

Referring to facts of the matter, it was submitted that now the witnesses already examined have to be recalled and trial of the case is likely to take sufficient long time, whereas applicant has already undergo detention of about more than four years.

It has been further submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 23.07.2021, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of deceased and that deceased has suffered death due to strangulation.

6. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, particularly the period of detention and stage of trial, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
7. The bail application is allowed.

sentences.text:
8. Let the applicant - Dhananjay Bajpayee involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

v. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
9. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

(Raj Beer Singh,J.) September 4, 2025 'SP'/-
